regs: An additional attack is added to the skill "Arrow Rain" per Registlet Level.
Raises the power of "Assassin Stab" by [Registlet Level]%. Furthermore, the accuracy is raised by [10 × Registlet Level]% if it is Back Stab.
Raises the damage dealt by pet by 3% per Registlet Level, but greatly decreases its owner's.
Releases a shock wave (single target attack). Dealing 10(+10 per Regislet Level)% damage if the monster targeted by "Aura Blade" is out of range
For each level of "Berserk", 10% chance to prevent "Rampage" from being cancelled.
Reduces the negative effect of "Berserk" by (1 × Regislet Level)% if you take damage from a monster while the skill is active
Modifies "Binding Strike" so that it inflicts [Stun] to the target only and the [Stop] effect is removed.
Raises the power of "Bloody Bite" by 10% per Registlet Level.
Raises normal attack power and Attack MP Recovery by 5% per Registlet Level while afflicted with Bleed.

Reduces the damage from monster attacks shown with a blue warning by 1(+1 per Regislet Level)%. However, damage taken from single-target attacks increases by 10%(disadvantage) This damage reduction applies multiplicatively with other damage reductions such as Refinement, Resistance
Raises the power of "Bullseye" by 5% per Registlet Level.
Restores MP as much as [5 × Registlet Level]% of your Attack MP Recovery when taking damage inflicted by Ignite.
Adds a [10 × Registlet Level]% chance of inflicting "Flinch" to the first attack of the skill "Cannon Spear".
A MISS hit while you are Blind may be turned into a GRAZE hit when possible.
Enables a trap skill to be set at the target's feet, but if it activates immediately, you will also be affected.
When you get knocked out, you will declare it through Party Chat. If it is a Guild RAID, you will declare it through Say Chat
Restores 10% of your HP when you defeat a monster. Cooldown: [30 - Registlet Level] seconds.
The chance of the familiar summoned with "Familia" fleeing is reduced by 1%. Movement becomes 1 second faster for Advanced Familiar.
Lowers the power of "Charging Slash" by [110 - (10 × Registlet Level)]% and guarantees a critical hit.
Raises the power of "Cross Parry" by 5% per Registlet Level.
Displays an additional warning message when stepping on a warning area if the damage from the attack exceeds 50% of your current HP
Sets skill effects that change based on element to dark element
Halves the duration of "Decoy Shot" but increases the power by 10% per Registlet Level.
The skill "Sonic Thrust" loses its swift effect, but gains an effect that ignores Evasion in return
Increases the power of "Buster Lance" by (10% per Regislet Level). The range and distance at which the power starts to weaken is Increased, making it always a long-range attack
The skill "Parabola Cannon" now only hits monsters currently in combat and guarantees a critical hit
Activation of "War Cry" will not be interrupted by Fear.
The time to cast [Fire Release] is increased by 1 second, but the skill gains (2.5 × Regislet Level)% Magic Pierce. This increase in Magic Pierce doubles if [Blazing Explosion] is triggered
Raises the power of the second hit of "Dragon Tail" by 5% per Registlet Level.
Reduces damage taken from behind (opposite camera direction) by 1% per Registlet Level. The damage will be further reduced when taken from directly behind.
Sets skill effects that change based on element to Earth element
Raises the power of "Earthbind" by 5% per Registlet Level if used with knuckles.
Converts the element of "Trigger Slash" from fire to that of the weapon equipped.
Reduces the MP Aggro triggered by "First Aid" by (1 × Regislet Level). Up to MP Cost 100 at the minimum.
Instantly restores [10 + Registlet Level]% of your HP when there is only 25% or less due to monster's attacks. Cooldown: 60 seconds
Immediately restores [10 × Registlet Level] MP if there is not enough MP. Cooldown: 60 seconds
There is a [5 × Registlet Level]% chance of having Armor Break status removed when the damage taken increases because of it.
Doubles the duration of the [Ether Flare] buff, but halves the buff's AMPR gain
Evasion becomes usable even with equipment that doesn't allow it
Gain [Invincible] for 1 second if [Floating Kick] is activated while moving
Reduces the Physical/Magic/Fractional Damage received by the mercenary or partner summoned as a "Defender" by (3 × Regislet Level)%
Removes [Knock Back] and [Slow] from "Assault Attack" and increases its power by 10% per Registlet Level
Adds a HP recovery effect to the skill "Recovery". The amount of HP restored is [10 × Registlet Level]% of the HP recovered by the Mini Heal learned.
"Chronos Shift" can be activated even if there is not enough MP by consuming HP. 60(-10% per Regislet Level)% HP is required per 100 MP you're short of. This HP consumption could get you knocked out
Increases the activation rate of "Concentrate" by 1% per Registlet Level.
Increases the activation rate of "Whack" by 1% per Registlet Level.
Changes the proration dealt by [Magic: Impact] to physical proration

If you get knocked out last in the party, you will squeeze out every last bit of your strength to quickly revive for [5 + Registlet Level] seconds before becoming unable to battle again. ∗ First Aid, Struggle, Revive Droplets Unavailable
Sets skill effects that change based on element to Fire element
Raises the power of "Flash Stab" by 5% per Registlet Level.
The power of "Demon Claw" is reduced by 100% but the skill will focus on attacking a single target
Turns the skill "Dive Impact" into an attack that pierces through a single target. Resistance to Dazzled is shortened by 2 seconds per Registlet Level.
"Resonance" will only enhance stats that affect concentration and precision, but the enhancement is reduced by [95 - (5 × Registlet Level)]%.
Shortens Sleep duration by 10% per Registlet Level.
Reduces the MP Cost of [Breathwork] by 100
Reduces the MP Cost of the skill "Heal" by 100.
Restores [10 × Registlet Level] MP when "Shield Bash" inflicts [Stun].
When "Qi Charge" gives no effect, qi will increase by [10 × Registlet Level]% if the skill is activated using 2000 MP.
Shortens the time for song effect to increase when used continuously by [Registlet Level] sec, but aggro and damage received while singing increase by 10%. *Does not apply to Fantasy Song.
Raises the power of "Hard Hit" by 5% per Registlet Level.

The amount of HP recovered by "Mini Heal" and "Heal" is halved. Accumulates up to [Registlet Level] stacks of buff every 3 sec. When using the skill to heal an ally, the buff is consumed instead of MP to activate it.
Alleviates the reduced recovery of Heal-related Regislets by (10% per Regislet Level)
There is a 1% chance that Lv[Registlet Level] light element Magic: Finale will activate when "Holy Light" hits the target.
Reduces movement speed decline due to Slow by 5% per Registlet Level.
Sets your own EXP Gain to 0 to increase the EXP Gain of the party member with the lowest level by 1% per Regislet Level. Less effective if there are multiple recipients

"Dauntless" accumulates 1 second faster, but the count will decrease by 9(- 3 per Regislet Level) when taking damage. However, it won't decrease if the damage is blocked with Guard or certain Mononofu skills
Guard Break increases by (1% per Regislet Level) when barehanded or equipping knuckles (main only). The amount increased will be tripled if sub-weapon is empty

Changes the additional attack effect of "Chronos Drive" from magic attack (based on INT) to physical attack (based on STR) Scaling remains the same. Proration usage of additional hits changes to physical proration
Raises the power of the second hit of "Issen" by 5% per Registlet Level.
Anticipate increases by 5% if a one-handed sword is equipped, Equipping a shield will triple the amount increased
Restores [10 + Registlet Level]% of your HP and MP per knocked out party member when you are the only one left. Cooldown: 300 seconds
Sets skill effects that change based on element to light element

All "Lunas Slash" stacks are now consumed and MP is restored based on the number of stacks consumed. MP recovery amount is 1 MP × Regislet Level × Lunar Slash Stack Consumed. Lunar Slash stack additional damage is disabled when equipping this regislet
Raises magic damage reduction by the skill "Magadachi" by 5% per Registlet Level.
Adds 1 shot per Registlet Level to the skill "Magic: Arrows".
Shortens the time to cast the skill "Magic: Blast" by 0.2 seconds per Registlet Level.
Shortens the interval between shots of the skill "Magic: Lances" by 0.1 seconds per Registlet Level.
Lowers the power of "Magic: Storm" by 50% to make its effect last 1s(+1s per Regislet Level) longer
Raises the power of "Magic: Wall" by 5% per Registlet Level.
Reduces the casting time of "Mana Crystal" by [10 × Registlet Level]%, but the amount of MP recovered gets reduced by 100.
Immediately restores 100 MP if you survive a Mana Explosion.
Raises normal attack power in exchange for Attack MP Recovery. ∗ Power increases more with higher Attack MP Recovery.
Switches [Maximizer] to activate MP Charge instead when used alone Not part of a combo and the condition for instant activation is not met
MP Cost of [Demon Wind Shuriken] increases by [200 - (100 × Regislet Level)], but, in exchange, the number of times the shuriken can hit without reduced damage is increased by 1
The range of "Royal Heal" effect is increased by 1m per Registlet Level, but the amount of HP restores is halved.
Increases the aggro generated by the skill "War Cry of Struggle" by 300 per Registlet Level.
The effect from "Meikyo Shisui" remains when using a skill.
The meteorites from "Magic: Crash" become much smaller in size, but the time of impact is shortened by (0.1 × Regislet Level - 0.1) and all meteorites will drop down even when not hitting the target
Restores 100 HP per 10 seconds when near a party member, but when not, 100 HP will be lost. Range is [3 + Registlet Level] meters. ∗ This HP loss won't knock player out.
Restores 100 MP when you defeat a monster. Cooldown: [30 - Registlet Level] seconds.
While "Crescent Saber" is active, all aggro generated will be reduced by 15% per Regislet Level. This effect does not activate if you are being targeted
Reduces the amount of ASPD lowered due to Paralysis by 2% per Registlet Level.
Restores [10 × Registlet Level] MP every 3 seconds, but all MP will be lost if you get aggro and this Registlet will be suspended for 30 seconds.
Extends the duration of buff from the skill "Paralysis Shot" by 1 second per Registlet Level.
A Guard check is added to the skill "Storm Blaze". A successful Guard will double the amount of MP recovered
Instead of consuming a triggered auto-item, the item cooldown is doubled. Cooldown: [40 - Registlet Level] seconds.
Restores (10 × Regislet Level) MP if [Triple Thrust] is successfully activated without taking any damage when used alone
Raises the power of "Phantom Slash" by 5% per Registlet Level.
Adds [5 × Registlet Level]% Physical Pierce to the skill "Heavy Smash" if used with knuckles.
[1 × Registlet Level]% chance of having Poison status removed when taking damage inflicted by Poison.
Extends the duration of Paralysis caused by the skill "Pommel Strike" by 1 second per Registlet Level.
"Resonance" will only enhance stats that affect firepower, but the enhancement is reduced by [95 - (5 × Registlet Level)]%.
Raises the power of "Power Shot" by 15% per Registlet Level when Tumble is inflicted.

Modifies the effect of "Power Wave" so that it raises normal attack power by [⌈(Registlet Level + Power Wave Level) × 0.5⌉]% instead of extending the range. ∗ The increment depends on the skill level.

When [Protection] is activated, the [Aegis] you've acquired will also be activated at the same time. Likewise, when [Aegis] is activated, the [Protection] you've acquired will also be activated at the same time
The power of "Twin Buster Blade" now increases based on the number of debuffs (max 1 types × Regislet Level ) on the target
Reduces damage taken by 1% per Registlet Level when you can't move while afflicted with Flinch, Tumble, or Stun.
The chance of having Freeze status removed if you do a normal attack while frozen increases by 5% per Registlet Level.
Raises the power of "Rage Sword" by 10% per Registlet Level. Aggro doubles if the target is hostile towards you.

Reduces the damage from monster attacks shown with a red warning by 1(+1 per Regislet Level)%. However, damage taken from single-target attacks increases by 10%(disadvantage) This damage reduction applies multiplicatively with other damage reductions such as Refinement, Resistance
Removes the finishing attack of the skill "Rampage" and restores 50 HP per Registlet Level.
Greatly suppresses your own damage output to increase your party members' EXP Gain by 1(+1 per Regislet Level)%
Grants a 10-second invincibility if you revive when all of your party members get knocked out.
Increases the activation rate of additional attack of "Secret Chase Attack" by 1% per level of the skill acquired.
Reduces aggro by [Registlet Level]% per 1 combo. Better effect with longer combo.
Each party member excluding you will raise ATK and MATK by 1%, but [110 - (10 × Registlet Level)]% of HP will be lost whenever a member gets knocked out. ∗ This HP loss could knock player out.
Raises the chance to inflict Armor Break with the skill "Shell Break" by 5% per Registlet Level.
Shortens the duration of dance skill effect by 5 seconds. *Does not apply to Spirited Dance.
Reduces the aggro generated when P. Defense is successful by [10 × Registlet Level]%
Increase amount of MP recovered by 5% per Registlet Level if "MP Charge" is used while afflicted with Silence.
Reduces the number of meteorites dropped from "Meteor Strike" to 1, but the drop point will no longer be random. It will no longer inflict status ailments either.
Raises the power of "Smash" by 5% per Registlet Level if used with knuckles.
Extends the duration of buff from the skill "Smoke Dust" by 1 second per Registlet Level.
The skill "Sneak Attack" changes into a time-based buff instead of remaining use-based
Extends the time you must reuse "Sonic Blade" to turn it into "Super Sonic Blade" by 1 second per Registlet Level.
Raises the power of "Sonic Wave" by 5% per Registlet Level if used with knuckles.
"Resonance" will only enhance stats that affect acceleration, but the enhancement is reduced by [95 - (5 × Registlet Level)]%.
Reduces the range of "Spinning Slash" and removes the knock back effect, but raises its power by 5% per Registlet Level.
Raises the power of "Spiral Air" by 2% per Registlet Level.
Sheathing while moving will no longer occur
Normal attack has 0 second cooldown for [5 + Registlet Level] seconds when getting aggro from the target monster for the first time. Cooldown: 60 seconds
You will remain in the same spot when using the skill "Triple Thrust".
Reduces damage taken while afflicted with Stop by 3% per Registlet Level if you stand still.
When using Emotions that increase Natural Regen, an additional [25 × Registlet Level]% of MP will be restored.
Adds 1 hit to the skill "Sword Tempest".
Lowers the damage received by pet by 3% per Registlet Level, but greatly increases the damage received by its owner.
When you are drawing the enemy's attention (aggro), you will declare it through Party Chat. If it is a Guild RAID, you will declare it through Say Chat

Lowers MaxMP by [1100 - (100 × Registlet Level)], but when you are knocked out, the remaining MP will be shared among your party members. ∗ Players whose MP gets restored by this effect cannot enjoy the same effect for 180 seconds.
Additional attack of "Shadow Walk" will no longer cause proration.
Raises the critical damage from "Twin Slash" by 1% per Registlet Level.
"Ether Flare" will recover Attack MP even if the element is not the target's weakness.
Adds Magic Pierce (5% per Regislet Level) attribute to the skill "Wind Release" and when the skill changes, an Unsheathe Attack attribute is added
While Storm Reaper's buff is active the skill "Lunar Misfortune" becomes a close-range attack regardless of distance. (15 - Regislet Level) seconds cooldown after activation
Changes "Water Release" from a deployable skill to a buff skill
Sets skill effects that change based on element to Water element
Increases EXP Gain by 10% but lowers damage dealt by [15 - Registlet Level]%.
Sets skill effects that change based on element to wind element
Damage dealt with skill activated without using a combo is multiplied by [1 + (0.01 × Registlet Level)]. *Does not apply to some skills such as charge skills.
